title: How a Judge Got to 150 Years (Bernie Madoff)

lines.say: June twenty-ninth, two thousand nine. Nine victims spoke before Bernie Madoff's sentence.
lines.show: June 29, 2009. Nine victims spoke before Bernie Madoff's sentence.

lines.say: One said she lived on food stamps, and sometimes scavenged in dumpsters.

scene.q: I live on food stamps. At the end of the month, I sometimes scavenge in dumpsters.

lines.say: Judge Denny Chin said the fraud was staggering, and the breach of trust was massive.

scene.q: Objectively speaking, the fraud was staggering … the breach of trust was massive.

lines.say: Then the math. Eleven counts. Each with a maximum. Six at twenty years, one at ten, four at five.
Add them up: exactly one hundred fifty.
And that is what he got. One hundred fifty years.
lines.show: And that is what he got. 150 years.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
